Which integral is obtained?

$$
\int \frac{3}{\sqrt{1 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "c021fecf-8c5b-589c-8771-db1b81163d9d" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=4 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(4)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{4}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $3\cdot \frac{1}{4}=\frac{3}{4}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{3}{\sqrt{1 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{3}{4}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "c021fecf-8c5b-589c-8771-db1b81163d9d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "c021fecf-8c5b-589c-8771-db1b81163d9d" :question/answer-fields "3e9a65a3-437c-5bff-b1cd-4390d744f6ec"] [:db/ensure "c021fecf-8c5b-589c-8771-db1b81163d9d" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186064218 :knowledge-point/questions "c021fecf-8c5b-589c-8771-db1b81163d9d"] [:db/add "c105b90b-ecb7-519a-a5b7-a96a06ae50fc" :answer/id #uuid "c105b90b-ecb7-519a-a5b7-a96a06ae50fc"] [:db/add "c105b90b-ecb7-519a-a5b7-a96a06ae50fc" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "c105b90b-ecb7-519a-a5b7-a96a06ae50fc" :answer/value "6\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - $$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 25 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "9877a1da-e8db-570d-b287-71b1a27bf31c" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{1}{5}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 25 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "9877a1da-e8db-570d-b287-71b1a27bf31c" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "9877a1da-e8db-570d-b287-71b1a27bf31c" :question/answer-fields "b1ca9dbc-ef6c-5002-b937-e30b39dc0a9b" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "b1ca9dbc-ef6c-5002-b937-e30b39dc0a9b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{3})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}=3\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{3})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=3\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{2}{3}\cdot 3=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2\left(\arcsin{\left(\frac{x}{3} \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "b1ca9dbc-ef6c-5002-b937-e30b39dc0a9b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "b1ca9dbc-ef6c-5002-b937-e30b39dc0a9b" :question/answer-fields "84707fca-407c-5ae0-9f6b-a8be35d06a68" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "84707fca-407c-5ae0-9f6b-a8be35d06a68" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{2}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{2})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}=2\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{2})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=2\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot 2=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2\left(\arcsin{\left(\frac{x}{2} \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "84707fca-407c-5ae0-9f6b-a8be35d06a68" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "84707fca-407c-5ae0-9f6b-a8be35d06a68" :question/answer-fields "6580d3c9-1b2c-5dd3-9425-0ec2eeba4c53"] [:db/add "6580d3c9-1b2c-5dd3-9425-0ec2eeba4c53" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "6580d3c9-1b2c-5dd3-9425-0ec2eeba4c53" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}=4\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{4})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=4\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot 4=4$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.

$$

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

$$
3\left(\arcsin{\left(\frac{x}{4} \right)}\right)+C.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{9 - 16 x^{2}}=3\sqrt{1-(\frac{4 x}{3})^2}.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{\sqrt{9 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\arcsin{\left(\frac{4 x}{3} \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "95398754-8d8a-50d4-bfa4-4cf30d049a32" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "95398754-8d8a-50d4-bfa4-4cf30d049a32" :question/answer-fields "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186" :question/id #uuid "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186"] [:db/add "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{4 - 9 x^{2}}=2\sqrt{1-(\frac{3 x}{2})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{2}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{2}{3}=\frac{1}{3}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{4 - 9 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{3}\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\arcsin{\left(\frac{3 x}{2} \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186" :question/answer-fields $$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 25 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$"] [:db/add "9877a1da-e8db-570d-b287-71b1a27bf31c" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=5 x$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(5)\,\mathrm{d}x$.

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{1}{5}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot \frac{1}{5}=\frac{1}{5}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - 25 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

The transformed integral is

$$
\frac{1}{5}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).
$$"] [:db/add "9877a1da-e8db-570d-b287-71b1a27bf31c" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] [:db/add "9877a1da-e8db-570d-b287-71b1a27bf31c" :question/answer-fields "b1ca9dbc-ef6c-5002-b937-e30b39dc0a9b" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "b1ca9dbc-ef6c-5002-b937-e30b39dc0a9b" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{3})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}=3\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{3})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=3\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{2}{3}\cdot 3=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2\left(\arcsin{\left(\frac{x}{3} \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "b1ca9dbc-ef6c-5002-b937-e30b39dc0a9b" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "b1ca9dbc-ef6c-5002-b937-e30b39dc0a9b" :question/answer-fields "84707fca-407c-5ae0-9f6b-a8be35d06a68" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{2}{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "84707fca-407c-5ae0-9f6b-a8be35d06a68" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{2}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{2})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}=2\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{2})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=2\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot 2=2$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{2}{\sqrt{4 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
2\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=2\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
2\left(\arcsin{\left(\frac{x}{2} \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "84707fca-407c-5ae0-9f6b-a8be35d06a68" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "84707fca-407c-5ae0-9f6b-a8be35d06a68" :question/answer-fields "6580d3c9-1b2c-5dd3-9425-0ec2eeba4c53"] [:db/add "6580d3c9-1b2c-5dd3-9425-0ec2eeba4c53" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

$$
\int \frac{4}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

You may use $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C$.

Choose the antiderivative. In each choice, $C$ is an arbitrary constant."] [:db/add "6580d3c9-1b2c-5dd3-9425-0ec2eeba4c53" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=\frac{x}{4}$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(\frac{1}{4})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}=4\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{4})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=4\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot 4=4$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.

$$

$$
3\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=3\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

$$
3\left(\arcsin{\left(\frac{x}{4} \right)}\right)+C.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{9 - 16 x^{2}}=3\sqrt{1-(\frac{4 x}{3})^2}.
$$

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{\sqrt{9 - 16 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u.\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\arcsin{\left(\frac{4 x}{3} \right)}+C.
$$"] [:db/add "95398754-8d8a-50d4-bfa4-4cf30d049a32" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "95398754-8d8a-50d4-bfa4-4cf30d049a32" :question/answer-fields "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186" :question/id #uuid "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186"] [:db/add "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{4 - 9 x^{2}}=2\sqrt{1-(\frac{3 x}{2})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=\frac{2}{3}\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $\frac{1}{2}\cdot \frac{2}{3}=\frac{1}{3}$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{4 - 9 x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{3}\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\arcsin{\left(\frac{3 x}{2} \right)}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/hard] [:db/add "fc157b00-d7e7-54d0-826d-effc6b6af186" :question/answer-fields $$"] ["c021fecf-8c5b-589c-8771-db1b81163d9d" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/easy] ["c021fecf-8c5b-589c-8771-db1b81163d9d" :question/answer-fields "3e9a65a3-437c-5bff-b1cd-4390d744f6ec"] [17592186064218 :knowledge-point/questions "c021fecf-8c5b-589c-8771-db1b81163d9d"] ["c105b90b-ecb7-519a-a5b7-a96a06ae50fc" :answer/id #uuid "c105b90b-ecb7-519a-a5b7-a96a06ae50fc"] ["c105b90b-ecb7-519a-a5b7-a96a06ae50fc" :answer/type :answer.type/math] ["c105b90b-ecb7-519a-a5b7-a96a06ae50fc" :answer/value "6\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - \int \frac{4}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Factor the constant in the denominator:

$$
\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}=4\sqrt{1-(\frac{x}{4})^2}.
$$

The differential is $\mathrm{d}x=4\,\mathrm{d}u$. The outside factor is $1\cdot 4=4$.

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int \frac{4}{\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
4\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=4\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$

$$"] ["6580d3c9-1b2c-5dd3-9425-0ec2eeba4c53" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] ["6580d3c9-1b2c-5dd3-9425-0ec2eeba4c53" :question/answer-fields "5df6d80a-9145-5b45-b0f6-b11cab1a6229"] $$
\sqrt{9 - 16 x^{2}}=3\sqrt{1-(\frac{4 x}{3})^2}.

$$

$$
\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u=\arcsin{\left(u \right)}+C.
$$

$$

$$
\sqrt{4 - 9 x^{2}}=2\sqrt{1-(\frac{3 x}{2})^2}.

$$

Use the supplied primitive:

$$
\frac{1}{3}\left(\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - u^{2}}}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{1}{3}\left(\arcsin{\left(u \right)}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$

$$
